name: innate spellcasting
desc:
The [[lookup @details.type.config.label lowercase]]{monster}'s innate spellcasting ability is Charisma. It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: detect magic, fog cloud, light
3/day each: feather fall, fly, misty step, telekinesis
1/day each: control weather, gaseous form
